description: France Chaleur Urbaine documents the data supporting its heating and cooling network map. The page identifies existing and planned networks, priority development areas, connected buildings, annual gas consumption and modelled heating and cooling needs. The provider is France Chaleur Urbaine. Coverage: Coverage is France, with network geometry and some building or address-level attributes. The page identifies 2024 source vintages for several inputs; these do not establish one common date for the entire service. Access: The provider publishes an interactive map and documentation linking each data source. The review inspected the public documentation, without obtaining layers. Licence and cost: The page describes open source datasets, but a common licence and downstream charging conditions are not stated. Each source requires its own terms check. Limitations: Residential consumption can be suppressed for confidentiality, and the page notes occasional industrial-sector misclassification of large boilers. For simulation it can support heat-network expansion and demand-allocation scenarios, with attention to source dates and confidentiality filters. Related resources: Related record data-hotmaps-building-stock-and-heat-density-maps offers a European heat-demand comparison; no direct data equivalence is implied.
